components.name: Tender Primary Action
components.description: Scoped tender action: white text on the darker tender emerald, with a 44px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-tender-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #00865f; border-radius: 9px; background: #00865f; color: #fff; font: 650 14px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Manrope, 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tender-primary:hover { background: #006f4f; } .ds-tender-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00865f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tender-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tender Secondary Action
components.description: Compact bordered action for tender details and owner management; disabled state preserves the label.
components.html: <button class="ds-tender-secondary">View details</button> <button class="ds-tender-secondary" disabled title="Editing is unavailable">Edit</button>
components.css: .ds-tender-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #e1e7ee; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #101820; font: 650 14px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Manrope, 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tender-secondary:hover { border-color: #9aaabd; background: #f8fafb; } .ds-tender-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00865f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tender-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

Full details are locked

Buy access to see the exact location, the client's conditions, and any attached files, and to send a free offer.

narrative.overview:
Tender is a construction marketplace, and a marketplace earns trust by showing what is actually open right now and by being explicit about the mechanism that closes a tender. The interface leads with live work — open tenders, offer counts, closing countdowns, category volumes — and states the rule that decides the winner rather than implying negotiation.

The system is built on the Tipalti EU foundations: near-black ink and paper carry the page, a single brand gold marks the one thing to do next, and a hairline grid motif signs every banded surface. Depth is soft and cool, never glassy. Numbers are typeset as quantities, not as decoration.

Every figure the interface states is counted from the same rows the rest of the product acts on. Where the platform does not measure something yet, the surface says so or leaves the space empty; it never fills a section with invented supply.
keyCharacteristics: Gold is the single pop, used for the primary action, the active tab and the live countdown — never as a background for body text.
A 1200px content column with 40px gutters governs every band, marketing and workspace alike.
Cards are the unit of structure: hairline border, soft cool shadow, 20-28px radius, and a raise on hover only where the card is a destination.
The grid motif is always masked with a fade, so it reads as a watermark rather than graph paper.
Privacy and selection rules are visible in the UI, not buried in copy.

rules.name: Scoped tender surface precedence
rules.body: The following tender subsections take precedence within that scope, including action text colour, card shape, elevation, and responsive layout. Existing homepage, authentication, discovery, wizard, and other surface guidance remains in force outside it.

rules.name: The No-White-On-Gold Rule
rules.body: Text on brand gold is always ink. White on gold fails contrast and is never used, including on hover and active states.

rules.name: The Single-Pop Rule
rules.body: One gold element owns each decision. If two gold elements compete inside a card, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Scarce-Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means verified or open, red means repair. Neither is decoration, and neither carries meaning by colour alone.

rules.name: The Tabular-Number Rule
rules.body: Any number a user compares — budget, offer amount, rating, count, coordinate — is set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Equal-Script Rule
rules.body: Georgian may wrap earlier, but it is never given a smaller role or a lighter weight than English. Display sizes are optically matched, never demoted.

rules.name: The One-Column Rule
rules.body: A collapsed layout reorders by decision priority, not by source order. On tender detail the unlock card moves above the description.

rules.name: The Raise-Means-Reachable Rule
rules.body: A hover raise promises a destination. A card that does not navigate does not raise.

rules.name: The Quiet-Basemap Rule
rules.body: The basemap is context, not content. It is desaturated so the pin and the area circle stay the loudest marks.

rules.name: The Coarse-Circle Rule
rules.body: A map shown before entitlement draws an area, never a point, and that area is sized from the real coordinate coarsening.

rules.name: The Map-Is-Enhancement Rule
rules.body: A map never becomes the only way to complete a task; the coordinate fields stay visible and functional beside it.

dos: Do show real supply: real open tenders, real counts, real reviews.
Do keep every number tabular and every number labelled.
Do reserve gold for the single next action on the surface.
Do state the selection rule wherever offers are shown.
Do test Georgian and English at 1280px, 1024px and 390px.
donts: Don't put white text on gold, anywhere, in any state.
Don't invent tenders, offers, ratings, revenue or statistics to fill a section. An empty section says it is empty; a placeholder says it is a placeholder.
Don't reveal client identity, exact location, attachments or conditions before an entitlement — the projection is enforced on the server, never by hiding markup on the client.
Don't use the grid motif unmasked, or at a density that competes with content.
Don't communicate status by colour alone.
